userDisable.description: Allows disabling or deleting managed users.

userSessionRead.description: Allows reading active refresh sessions for a specified user.

userSessionRevoke.description: Allows revoking refresh sessions for a specified user.

roleDelete.description: Allows deleting custom roles that satisfy the lifecycle requirements.

monitorServerStatusRead.description: Allows reading the server status overview.

moduleRuntimeRead.description: Allows reading the core module runtime snapshot.

accessLogRead.description: Allows reading canonical access-log explorer data.

appLogRead.description: Allows reading logger-owned app-log explorer data.

appLogDelete.description: Allows explicitly deleting retained app-log records.

systemConfigRead.description: Allows reading registered system configuration definitions and effective values.

systemConfigWrite.description: Allows writing and resetting administrator configuration overrides.

scheduledTaskRead.description: Allows reading scheduled task runtime data and run history.

scheduledTaskCreate.description: Allows creating user-managed scheduled task instances.

scheduledTaskDelete.description: Allows deleting user-managed scheduled task instances.

scheduledTaskRun.description: Allows manually running scheduled task runtime jobs.

scheduledTaskEnable.description: Allows enabling and disabling scheduled tasks.

announcementUpdate.description: Allows updating announcement drafts and management metadata.

auditRead.description: Allows viewing the audit overview and audit logs.

auditManage.description: Allows managing audit visibility defaults and per-event overrides.

securityOverviewRead.description: Allows reading the aggregate security overview across access control and audit signals.

containerView.description: Allows viewing the container management list.

containerEvents.description: Allows reading bounded container runtime event history and live event streams.

containerEnvironment.description: Allows reading container environment variable values when display policy permits them.

containerShell.description: Allows creating interactive shell sessions for running containers.

containerStart.description: Allows starting stopped containers when dangerous actions are enabled.

containerStop.description: Allows stopping running containers when dangerous actions are enabled.

containerRestart.description: Allows restarting containers when dangerous actions are enabled.

containerRemove.description: Allows deleting containers when dangerous actions are enabled.

containerVolumeRemove.description: Allows removing Docker volumes, including force removal when enabled.

dockerImagePull.description: Allows pulling images from registries configured for the Docker daemon.

dockerImageTag.description: Allows adding Repository:Tag references to local Docker images.

dockerImageUntag.description: Allows removing a Repository:Tag reference from a local Docker image without force deletion.

dockerImageRemove.description: Allows deleting local Docker images; force deletion requires explicit confirmation.

applicationView.description: Read registered Compose application summaries and readonly details.

applicationImport.description: Validate and import external Compose applications into the application registry.

applicationRefresh.description: Refresh application snapshots and readonly configuration projections.

applicationLifecycle.description: Run bounded Compose lifecycle actions such as up, stop, and restart.

applicationDestroy.description: Run unregister and guarded destroy actions for application records.

applicationCreate.description: View managed root settings and create managed Compose applications.

applicationCreationMethodView.description: View supported Compose application creation methods and their availability.

projectCreationMethodView.description: View supported Compose application creation methods and their availability.

applicationDiscoveryView.description: Preview discovered local Compose directories without registering an application.

applicationDeploy.description: Diff, validate, and deploy managed application configuration drafts.

notificationView.description: Allows reading current-user notifications and unread counts.

notificationRead.description: Allows marking current-user notifications as read or deleting current-user deliveries.

notificationManage.description: Allows managing global notification delivery and settings.

runtimeTargetView.description: Allows reading runtime target connection and capability state.

runtimeTargetManage.description: Reserved for future runtime target configuration management.

runtimeTargetRefresh.description: Allows refreshing runtime target availability and capabilities.

runtimeTargetAssignmentManage.description: Allows granting and revoking deployment use of runtime targets.

applicationTemplateManage.description: Create, edit, derive, import, and archive reusable Application templates.

applicationTemplatePublish.description: Publish immutable Application template versions for creators.
